effyeahpetrats:

So, my rat Pocket had an unexpected litter. They’ll be 3 weeks old on Friday. I’ve already found homes for the 6 females, but now I’m left with 2 males (The two black hooded ones). I would keep them if I could, but unfortunately I can’t. I live in the Southern California area, and the two boys are free to a good home. Unfortunately, I can’t meet anyone half way, since I don’t have a car. I work with the pups daily. I play with them everyday, and they are use to people. I’m not giving them away individually. The two males are sticking together. If interested, let me know!
(If anyone wants to adopt one of these gorgeous babies and lives in or around the Southern California area, please leave a message in sugaredtangerines’s ask box HERE.)
